title.raw: 卷二十九 志第五 五行二 Volume 29 Treatises 5: Five Elements 2

sentences.zh: 志第五 五行二

translations.literal: Treatise 5, Five Elements 2.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on the Five Elements, Part Two.

translations.literal: Section marker (opening bracket in source).
translations.idiomatic: Fire and Wood

sentences.zh: （火 木）〉

translations.literal: (Fire, Wood)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Fire and Wood sections).

sentences.zh: 《洪範》曰：「火曰炎上。

translations.literal: The Hong Fan says: "Fire is called flaming upward."
translations.idiomatic: The Hong Fan states: "Fire is defined as flaming upward."

sentences.zh: 」火不炎上，則失其性矣。

translations.literal: When fire does not flame upward, it loses its nature.
translations.idiomatic: When fire fails to rise and burn upward, it has forsaken its proper nature.

sentences.zh: 前史多以恆燠、草異、火、木、羽蟲之孽、羊禍、火災、火異、赤眚赤祥皆屬之火，今從之。

translations.literal: Earlier histories mostly classified persistent warmth, grass anomalies, fire, wood, bird-and-insect calamities, sheep portents, fire disasters, fire anomalies, and red afflictions and red omens under fire; this follows them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier dynastic histories grouped persistent warmth, grass anomalies, fires, wood anomalies, calamities among birds and insects, sheep portents, conflagrations, fire omens, and red afflictions and red auspices under the element Fire; this chapter follows that convention.

sentences.zh: ▲恆燠

translations.literal: ▲ Persistent warmth
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Persistent Warmth

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年正月癸未，以京師一冬不雪，詔諭修省。

translations.literal: Hongxi year 1, first month, day guimao: because the capital had had no snow all winter, an edict was issued urging cultivation and self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1, first month, day guimao: with no snow all winter in the capital, the throne issued an edict calling for moral cultivation and self-examination.

sentences.zh: 正統九年冬，畿內外無雪。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 9, winter: within and without the capital region, no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 9, winter: no snow fell inside or outside the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 十二年冬，陝西無雪。

translations.literal: Year 12, winter: Shaanxi had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 12, winter: Shaanxi had no snow.

sentences.zh: 景泰六年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 6, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 6, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 天順元年冬，宮中祈雪。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 1, winter: snow was prayed for within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 1, winter: the palace held prayers for snow.

sentences.zh: 是年，直隸、山西、河南、山東皆無雪。

translations.literal: That year, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Shandong all had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Shandong all went without snow.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，命百官祈雪。

translations.literal: Year 2, winter: all officials were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, winter: the court ordered all officials to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，直隸、山東、河南皆無雪。

translations.literal: Year 6, winter: Zhili, Shandong, and Henan all had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 6, winter: Zhili, Shandong, and Henan again had no snow.

sentences.zh: 成化元年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 1, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 1, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，燠如夏。

translations.literal: Year 5, winter: warm as summer.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 5, winter: the weather was as warm as summer.

sentences.zh: 六年二月壬申，以自冬徂春，雨雪不降，敕諭羣臣親詣山川壇請禱。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, day renshen: because from winter through spring rain and snow had not fallen, an imperial command urged the ministers in person to go to the mountain-and-river altars to offer prayers.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 6, second month, day renshen: with no rain or snow from winter into spring, an edict directed the ministers in person to the mountain-and-river altars to pray.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，南京、山東奏，冬春恆燠，無冰雪。

translations.literal: Year 10, second month: Nanjing and Shandong reported that winter and spring had been persistently warm, with no ice or snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 10, second month: Nanjing and Shandong reported persistent warmth through winter and spring and no ice or snow.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，以無雪祈禱。

translations.literal: Year 11, winter: prayers were offered because of no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 11, winter: prayers were held for lack of snow.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，直隸、山東、河南、山西無雪。

translations.literal: Year 15, winter: Zhili, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 15, winter: Zhili, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi had no snow.

sentences.zh: 十九年冬，京師、直隸無雪。

translations.literal: Year 19, winter: the capital and Zhili had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 19, winter: the capital and Zhili had no snow.

sentences.zh: 弘治九年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 9, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 9, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 15, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 15, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 十八年冬，溫如春，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 18, winter: mild as spring, no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 18, winter: the weather was mild as spring and there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 正德元年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 永嘉自冬至春，麥穗桃李實。

translations.literal: From winter solstice through spring, wheat ears and peach-plum fruit.
translations.idiomatic: From the winter solstice into spring, wheat put forth ears and peaches and plums bore fruit.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 3, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 3, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 六年至九年，連歲無雪。

translations.literal: Years 6 through 9: successive years without snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 6 through 9: snow failed for four years running.

sentences.zh: 十一年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 11, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 11, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十四年，冬深無雪，遣官遍祭諸神。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 14: deep into winter, still no snow; officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices broadly to the gods.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 14: deep into winter there was still no snow, and the court sent officials to sacrifice widely to the gods.

sentences.zh: 十九年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 19, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 19, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 二十年十二月癸卯，禱雪於神祇壇。

translations.literal: Year 20, twelfth month, day guimao: snow was prayed for at the Altar of the Spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 20, twelfth month, day guimao: prayers for snow were offered at the Altar of the Spirits.

sentences.zh: 二十四年十二月甲午，命諸臣分告宮廟祈雪。

translations.literal: Year 24, twelfth month, day jiawu: ministers were ordered to divide among them in reporting to palace temples to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 24, twelfth month, day jiawu: ministers were ordered to divide among themselves and petition the palace temples for snow.

sentences.zh: 三十二年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 32, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 32, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 三十三年十二月壬申，以災異屢見，即禱雪日爲始，百官青衣辦事。

translations.literal: Year 33, twelfth month, day renshen: because calamities and anomalies had repeatedly appeared, from the day of praying for snow onward all officials were to conduct affairs in blue garments.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 33, twelfth month, day renshen: with calamities and anomalies recurring, the court made the snow-prayer day the start of a period in which all officials were to wear blue and conduct state business.

sentences.zh: 三十六年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 36, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 36, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 三十九年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 39, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 39, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 明年，又無雪。

translations.literal: The next year, again no snow.
translations.idiomatic: The following year again brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 帝將躬禱，會大風，命亟禱雪兼禳風變。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to pray in person when a great wind arose; he ordered urgent prayer for snow together with expiation of the wind anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was preparing to pray in person when a great wind rose; he ordered snow prayers at once, combined with rites to avert the wind omen.

sentences.zh: 四十一年至四十五年冬，祈雪無虛歲。

translations.literal: Years 41 through 45, winter: praying for snow was not absent in any year.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 41 through 45: every winter saw snow prayers.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Longqing year 1, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 1, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Year 4, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 4, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四年十二月己丑，命禮部祈雪。

translations.literal: Wanli year 4, twelfth month, day jichou: the Ministry of Rites was ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 4, twelfth month, day jichou: the Ministry of Rites was ordered to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 十六年、十七年、二十九年、三十七年、四十七年，亦如之。

translations.literal: Years 16, 17, 29, 37, and 47 were also like this.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 16, 17, 29, 37, and 47 saw the same.

sentences.zh: 崇禎五年十二月癸酉，命順天府祈雪。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 5, twelfth month, day guiyou: Shuntian Prefecture was ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 5, twelfth month, day guiyou: Shuntian Prefecture was ordered to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 六年、七年冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Years 6 and 7, winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6 and 7, winter: no snow.

sentences.zh: ▲草異

translations.literal: ▲ Grass anomalies
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grass Anomalies

sentences.zh: 永樂十六年正月乙丑，同州、澄城、觔陽、朝邑雨谷及蕎麥。

translations.literal: Yongle year 16, first month, day yichou: Tongzhou, Chengcheng, Jinyang, and Chaoyi rained grain together with buckwheat.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 16, first month, day yichou: at Tongzhou, Chengcheng, Jinyang, and Chaoyi grain and buckwheat fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 正統八年十一月，殿上生荊棘，高二尺。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 8, eleventh month: brambles grew on the palace hall, two chi high.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 8, eleventh month: brambles sprouted on the palace hall floor, standing two chi high.

sentences.zh: 十四年，廣州獄竹牀逾年忽青生葉。

translations.literal: Year 14: at Guangzhou prison a bamboo bed, after more than a year, suddenly turned green and put forth leaves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14: in the Guangzhou prison a bamboo bed that had stood for more than a year suddenly turned green and sprouted leaves.

sentences.zh: 成化六年二月戊寅，湖廣應山雨粟。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 6, second month, day wuyin: Huguang Yingshan rained millet.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 6, second month, day wuyin: at Yingshan in Huguang millet rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 弘治八年二月，枯竹開花，實如麥米。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 8, second month: withered bamboo flowered, its fruit like wheat grain.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 8, second month: withered bamboo blossomed, bearing fruit like wheat kernels.

sentences.zh: 苦蕒開蓮花。

translations.literal: Bitter greens opened lotus flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Bitter-greens plants bore lotus blossoms.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，黟縣雨豆，味不可食。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: Yi County rained beans, inedible in taste.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, day jiazi: at Yi County beans rained down, foul and inedible.

sentences.zh: 九年，黃州民家瓜大如鬥，瓤皆赤血。

translations.literal: Year 9: at Huangzhou a commoner's melon was as large as a dou, its flesh all red blood.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 9: at Huangzhou a villager's melon grew as large as a dou, its flesh entirely red as blood.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十三年四月戊寅，石首雨豆，大小不一，色雜紅黑。

translations.literal: Wanli year 43, fourth month, day wuyin: Shishou rained beans, large and small mixed, colors mingled red and black.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 43, fourth month, day wuyin: at Shishou beans rained down in mixed sizes and mottled red and black hues.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年、五年，河南草生人馬形，如被甲持矛馳驅戰鬥者然。

translations.literal: Chongzhen years 4 and 5: in Henan grass grew in the shapes of men and horses, as if armored and holding spears, galloping in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 4 and 5: in Henan grass formed human and equine shapes, as though armored figures on horseback charged with spears.

sentences.zh: 十三年，徐州田中白豆，多作人面，眉目宛然。

translations.literal: Year 13: in fields at Xuzhou white beans, many bearing human faces with features clearly defined.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: in the fields of Xuzhou white beans appeared, many bearing human faces with distinct brows and eyes.

sentences.zh: ▲羽蟲之孽

translations.literal: ▲ Calamities among birds and insects
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Calamities among Birds and Insects

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十五年二月壬午，嶽州民家有鴨，含絮裹火，飛上屋，入竹椽茅茨中。

translations.literal: Wanli year 25, second month, day renwu: at Yuezhou a commoner's household had a duck that held cotton wrapped in fire, flew onto the roof, and entered bamboo rafters and thatch.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, second month, day renwu: at Yuezhou a villager's duck carried cotton wrapped around fire, flew onto the roof, and entered the bamboo rafters and thatch.

sentences.zh: 火四起，延燒數百家。

translations.literal: Fires broke out on four sides, spreading to burn several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Flames erupted on every side and the blaze spread to several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 四十三年四月壬午，雙鶴銜火，飛集掖縣海神廟殿。

translations.literal: Year 43, fourth month, day renwu: a pair of cranes held fire in their beaks and flew to perch on the hall of the Sea God Temple at Ye County.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 43, fourth month, day renwu: two cranes carried fire in their beaks and flew to alight on the main hall of the Sea God Temple at Ye County.

sentences.zh: 明日，廟火。

translations.literal: The next day, the temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: The following day the temple burned.

sentences.zh: 崇禎六年，汝寧有鳥，鳩身猴足。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 6: at Runing there was a bird with a dove's body and a monkey's feet.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6: at Runing a bird appeared with a dove's body and monkey's feet.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽惡鳥數萬，兔頭、雞身、鼠足，供饌甚肥，犯其骨立死。

translations.literal: At Fengyang tens of thousands of evil birds, with rabbit heads, chicken bodies, and rat feet, were very fat when offered as food; whoever ate their bones died at once.
translations.idiomatic: At Fengyang tens of thousands of malign birds with rabbit heads, chicken bodies, and rat feet grew fat enough to serve as food; anyone who ate their bones died immediately.

sentences.zh: ▲羊禍

translations.literal: ▲ Sheep portents
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Sheep Portents

sentences.zh: 萬曆三十八年四月，崞縣民家羊產羔，一首、二眼、四耳、二尾、八足。

translations.literal: Wanli year 38, fourth month: at Guo County a commoner's sheep bore a lamb with one head, two eyes, four ears, two tails, and eight feet.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38, fourth month: at Guo County a villager's ewe bore a lamb with one head, two eyes, four ears, two tails, and eight feet.

sentences.zh: 三十九年四月，降夷部產羊羔，人面羊身。

translations.literal: Year 39, fourth month: among the surrendered tribes a lamb was born with a human face and sheep body.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 39, fourth month: among the surrendered tribes a lamb was born with a human face on a sheep's body.

sentences.zh: ▲火災

translations.literal: ▲ Fire disasters
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Fire Disasters

sentences.zh: 建文二年八月癸巳，承天門災。

translations.literal: Jianwen year 2, eighth month, day jisi: the Chengtian Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen 2, eighth month, day jisi: the Chengtian Gate burned.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年十二月辛亥，甌寧王邸第火，王薨。

translations.literal: Yongle year 4, twelfth month, day xinhai: the residence of the Prince of Ouning burned; the prince died.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 4, twelfth month, day xinhai: the residence of the Prince of Ouning burned and the prince perished.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月壬子，北京午門災。

translations.literal: Year 13, first month, day renzi: the Beijing Meridian Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 13, first month, day renzi: the Meridian Gate at Beijing burned.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月庚子，奉天、謹身、華蓋三殿災。

translations.literal: Year 19, fourth month, day gengzi: the three halls Fengtian, Jinshen, and Huagai burned.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 19, fourth month, day gengzi: the three main halls—Fengtian, Jinshen, and Huagai—burned.

sentences.zh: 二十年閏十二月戊寅，乾清宮災。

translations.literal: Year 20, intercalary twelfth month, day wuyin: the Qianqing Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 20, intercalary twelfth month, day wuyin: the Qianqing Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年三月己亥，東嶽泰山廟火。

translations.literal: Xuande year 3, third month, day jihai: the Eastern Peak Mount Tai temple burned.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 3, third month, day jihai: the temple of the Eastern Peak at Mount Tai burned.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，武昌火，延燒楚王宮，譜系敕符俱燼。

translations.literal: Year 6, eighth month: fire at Wuchang spread to burn the Prince of Chu's palace; genealogical registers and imperial commissions were all reduced to ash.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6, eighth month: fire at Wuchang spread into the Prince of Chu's palace, destroying genealogical registers and imperial commissions alike.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，天津右衛北城外火，飛焰入城，燒倉廒。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: fire north of the city wall outside Tianjin Right Guard; flying flames entered the city and burned the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Day jiachen: fire broke out north of the outer wall at Tianjin Right Guard; flying flames entered the city and burned the granaries.

sentences.zh: 九年二月庚午，京城東南樓火。

translations.literal: Year 9, second month, day gengwu: fire at the southeastern tower of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 9, second month, day gengwu: the southeastern tower of the capital burned.

sentences.zh: 正統二年二月，西鎮吳山廟火。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 2, second month: the Wushan Temple at Xizhen burned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2, second month: the Wushan Temple at Xizhen burned.

sentences.zh: 三年八月辛酉，順天貢院火，席舍多焚，改期再試。

translations.literal: Year 3, eighth month, day xinyou: the Shuntian examination compound burned; many examination cells were destroyed and the examinations were rescheduled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 3, eighth month, day xinyou: the Shuntian examination compound burned, many cells were destroyed, and the examinations were postponed and held again.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，韓府承運殿災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yihai: the Chengyun Hall of the Han princely establishment burned.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, day yihai: the Chengyun Hall of the Han princely establishment burned.

sentences.zh: 四年三月戊午，代府寢殿火。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, day wuwu: the sleeping hall of the Dai princely establishment burned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4, third month, day wuwu: the sleeping quarters of the Dai princely establishment burned.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，廣昌木廠火，焚松木八千八百餘株。

translations.literal: Year 7, first month: fire at the Guangchang timber yard burned more than eight thousand eight hundred pine logs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 7, first month: fire at the Guangchang timber yard destroyed more than eight thousand eight hundred pine logs.

sentences.zh: 戊午，南京內府火，燔廊房六十餘間，圖籍、器用、守衛衣甲皆空。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: fire in the Nanjing inner palace; more than sixty corridor rooms burned, and maps, registers, utensils, and guard armor were all lost.
translations.idiomatic: Day wuwu: fire in the Nanjing inner palace burned more than sixty corridor rooms; maps, registers, utensils, and guard armor were all consumed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，趙城媧皇寢廟火。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: the sleeping temple of the Queen Mother of Zhao burned.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, day xinwei: the sleeping temple of the Queen Mother of Zhao burned.

sentences.zh: 十年正月庚寅，忠義前後二衛災。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, day gengyin: disaster at the front and rear Zhongyi Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 10, first month, day gengyin: disaster struck the front and rear Zhongyi Guards.

sentences.zh: 是時太倉屢火，遣官禱祭火龍及太歲以禳之。

translations.literal: At that time Taicang repeatedly caught fire; officials were dispatched to pray and sacrifice to the Fire Dragon and the Grand Year Star to expiate it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Taicang suffered repeated fires; officials were sent to pray and sacrifice to the Fire Dragon and the Grand Year Star to avert the omen.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，忠義後衛倉復火。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: the rear Zhongyi Guard granary burned again.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, day jiashen: the rear Zhongyi Guard granary burned again.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，通州右衛倉火。

translations.literal: Day jisi: fire at the Tongzhou Right Guard granary.
translations.idiomatic: Day jisi: the Tongzhou Right Guard granary burned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，御花房火。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingyou: the imperial flower quarters burned.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, day dingyou: the imperial flower quarters burned.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，武昌火。

translations.literal: Year 11, autumn: fire at Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 11, autumn: fire at Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 死者數百人。

translations.literal: Several hundred people died.
